Noah (CS): Quick sync for HelioMint dedicated bring-up. Need to lock quota buckets, billing visibility, and load-test windows before the enablement next week. cc @Priya @Carmen @Liam
Priya (Eng): Got the contract numbers: committed 100 rps sustained, peak 350 rps for 10m bursts. They want linear ramp over 60 days to full commit. Any constraints on ephemeral burst budget?
Liam (AE): Customer wants predictable cost line. They asked that bursts be billed to a separate line item so their finance team can track overages. Approving that will unblock sign-off.
Carmen (SRE): We can tag burst nodes with route:heliomint_burst and emit billing-tag metrics. Need ops approval for allowing ephemeral pool to scale to +4x base during probes.
Noah (CS): Ops approval pending. Liam can you confirm finance ok with separate bucket? If yes we'll request burst budget from infra.
Liam (AE): Finance approved separate bucket as long as usage retention is 30 days in Console.
Priya (Eng): Cool. For autoscale policy, proposing "dedicated-helle-bounded": base capacity = 120 tokens/sec, scale target = cpu < 65% across pool, max replicas = base * 4. Includes warm-warmup prefetching. Thoughts?
Carmen (SRE): I prefer policy tied to token throughput rather than CPU. Suggest: scale when 90th percentile queue length > 25ms for 2m, and maintain min-ready instances to avoid cold-starts. Also set cool-down = 90s to prevent flip-flopping.
Priya (Eng): Token throughput metric exists but is noisy. We can combine both: token-based primary, fallback to CPU if tokens unavailable. Implement cooldown and min-ready = 2 replicas.
Noah (CS): Load-test plan: 1) Cache prime: 2h at 60% commit to populate prefix/KV cache; 2) Stress probe: 45m with repeated 10m spikes to 350 rps; 3) Regression sweep: 1h with mixed seq lengths (16/128/512). Prefer tests Tue 03:00-06:00 PT to minimize impact.
Carmen (SRE): Tue 03:00 PT works. I'll reserve the slot, runbook steps: rollback on >1% 5xx or sustained p95 > 300ms for 15m.
Priya (Eng): I'll prepare k6 scenario. Sample command: ```k6 run --vus 200 --duration 45m --rps 350 ./load/heliomint_mixed.js``` plus a short priming scenario.
Noah (CS): Success criteria: p95 < 250ms, error rate < 0.75%, < 3 cold-starts during any 10m surge window. If breached, trigger customer SWAT and record in renewal tracker.
Liam (AE): Note on renewal: they've got a 6-month review clause. If first 30 days show repeated SLO misses, we offer a one-off optimization engagement and a credit toward next term. Add to renewal playbook.
ops-bot: autoscale policy "dedicated-helle-bounded" planned deployment requested by Priya at 2024-04-04T12:34:22Z
Carmen (SRE): Staging rollout scheduled. I'll run a quick canary now and post metrics.
Priya (Eng): Drafting instrumentation: tag metrics, prefix-cache hit ratio, token-split histogram (16/64/256/512), burst-bucket consumption. Will push dashboards under Console > HelioMint.
Noah (CS): Also prepare a 3-question feedback form for the enablement: 1) Did priming docs reduce your latency? 2) Is billing visibility adequate? 3) Any blockers for production cutover? Priya, can you add a tiny example snippet for priming in the docs?
Priya (Eng): Sure. Example: ```// priming example pseudocode
for (const prompt of warm_prompts) { await client.generate(prompt, {cache:true}); }```
Liam (AE): I'll get finance to sign the billing tag consent doc and post here.
Carmen (SRE): Canary metrics: p95=195ms, error rate=0.12%, cache-hit=71% with prefix warmed. All good so far.
Noah (CS): Great. Action list: Liam - finance consent; Priya - k6 scripts + docs snippet; Carmen - schedule tests + canary + runbook; Noah - send enablement invite + feedback form + collect HelioMint token distributions.
Priya (Eng): Working on scripts, will drop by EOD.
Carmen (SRE): Tests booked Tue 03:00-06:00 PT. Will post run results in this thread.
Liam (AE): Finance consent uploaded: shared drive link (internal) <https://drive.company/heliomint-finance>
Noah (CS): Thanks team. If anything changes, update here. Otherwise I'll follow up with calendar invites and the feedback link tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
